title: Employment, Counsel
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At  Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

As Employment Counsel on the Employment Legal team, you'll provide day-to-day employment law counseling and compliance support across Coinbase's global workforce of approximately 5,000 employees in 20+ countries. This team owns all aspects of global employment legal, from people relations counseling and employment agreements to HR compliance, employment litigation, and the emerging intersection of AI and employment law. You'll independently manage a counseling portfolio covering performance management, disciplinary matters, and exits while supporting employment agreements, HR compliance, and AI tool deployment compliance for the People team.

What you'll do:

• Own a people relations counseling portfolio, providing first-line legal support on performance management, disciplinary processes, accommodations, policy questions, and exits across the full company.

• Advise on international employment matters across our 20+ country footprint, partnering with outside local counsel and HR on cross-border questions, country expansions, and EMEA and APAC employee issues.

• Support employment agreement workflows, including offer letter review, standard separation agreements, transfer letters, and relocation agreements, working from established templates and escalating complex matters.

• Drive tactical compliance support for the People team's deployment of AI tools in recruiting and HR, reviewing specific tool deployments against Coinbase's AI employment law compliance framework, advising on bias audit obligations, and drafting required notices and disclosures.

• Partner with the People team on HR compliance matters, including EEO-1 reporting, OFCCP obligations, and pay equity compliance, contributing to the team's global compliance program as it expands in scope.

• Support employment litigation and administrative proceedings, including drafting EEOC position statements, coordinating with outside counsel, managing litigation holds, and assisting with discovery on active matters.

• Track employment law developments and turn them into practical guidance for HR partners.

Required Skills and Experience:

• J.D. with active U.S. state bar membership and 5+ years of employment law experience, including meaningful in-house experience advising HR business partners on the full range of employment matters.

• Strong U.S. advice-and-counsel experience across performance management, terminations, accommodations and leaves. Experience with hourly or customer experience populations is a plus. Experience counseling on international employment matters is a plus.

• Hands-on experience with employment litigation and administrative charges, including position statements, discovery, litigation holds and outside counsel coordination.

• Working knowledge of U.S. HR compliance requirements (EEO-1 reporting, OFCCP, pay equity) and demonstrated engagement with the emerging AI and employment law regulatory landscape.

• Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Director, Partner Solution Engineer
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

As Docker continues its rapid growth, we're seeking an inspiring and experienced Director of Partner Solution Engineering to lead a world-class team. Docker helps organizations solve complex challenges in modern software supply chains, security governance, and AI-driven development. This role offers the opportunity to shape how our strategic partners, including ISVs, CSPs, SIs, and VARs, adopt and deliver transformative technologies that make developers more productive and secure.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Partner Solution Engineering, you will lead a high-performing technical organization responsible for driving partner enablement, joint go-to-market initiatives, and technical excellence across Docker's partner ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with Partner Sales, Technical Alliances, Product, and Engineering to develop scalable technical partnership strategies that help partners successfully integrate, sell, and deliver Docker's platform. Your focus will be on enabling your team to drive partner technical readiness, co-innovation, and mutual customer success while building repeatable models for partner engagement at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

LEADERSHIP & TEAM DEVELOPMENT

- Lead, develop, and inspire a team of Partner Solution Engineers, ensuring professional growth and high performance across multiple partner segments (ISVs, CSPs, SIs, VARs).

- Build and scale the Partner SE organization to support Docker's expanding partner ecosystem and geographic coverage.

- Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning focused on partner success and technical excellence.

- Coach, mentor, and empower your team to engage effectively with diverse partner organizations and communicate complex technical concepts clearly.

PARTNER ENABLEMENT & TECHNICAL STRATEGY

- Establish repeatable processes and programs for partner technical enablement, including scalable learning paths, certifications, technical deep-dives, and integration workshops.

- Design and deliver both 1:1 strategic enablement for key partners and 1-to-many programs that drive adoption across the broader partner ecosystem.

- Create technical content, integration guides, architectural diagrams, reference architectures, and enablement videos tailored for partners.

- Develop partner-specific technical sales plays, solution validation frameworks, and proof-of-value methodologies that highlight Docker's differentiated value.

JOINT GO-TO-MARKET EXECUTION

- Partner with the Partner Sales organization to drive joint account planning, co-selling opportunities, and "sell-with" and "sell-through" motions.

- Guide partners through solution design, technical validation, and evaluation processes to achieve joint customer success and sales goals.

- Support product positioning and technical validation during joint sales engagements, ensuring clarity on what's GA and ready for delivery.

- Define and track metrics for partner technical readiness, engagement quality, and revenue impact.

PRODUCT & ALLIANCE COLLABORATION

- Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share Voice of the Partner, influencing roadmap priorities and co-building initiatives.

Зараз ми в пошуку Personal Assistant для C-level. Це позиція для впевненого фахівця з високим рівнем автономності, який гнучко перемикається між особистими й бізнесовими запитами керівників будь-якої складності - вміє миттєво оцінити задачу, знайти оптимальне рішення та довести його до кінця без нагляду.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:
- Виконання задач від СЕО (від подарунків для бізнес-партнерів до організації складної логістики);

- Пошук інформації, аналіз та виконання ситуативних ad-hoc задач.

Що для нас важливо:
- Досвід від 2-3 років на посаді Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant або суміжній;
- Зрілість, автономність та вміння швидко розставляти пріоритети;

Буде перевагою:
- Досвід супроводу кількох керівників одночасно;
- Напрацьована база перевірених сервісів та підрядників.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

title: Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (w/m/d)
description:
Job description

For years, StackFuel has been one of Germany’s leading providers of data and AI training. Since early 2026, we have been part of Multiverse, Europe’s only EdTech unicorn and the continent’s largest AI upskilling platform. Together, we are pursuing a clear goal: to make 100,000 employees in Germany AI-ready and close the country’s data and AI skills gap.

To make this happen, we are building a next-generation adaptive learning platform from Berlin, AI-first from the ground up. Alongside this, we develop software tools and automations that integrate into our customers’ B2B platforms. As a Senior Fullstack AI Engineer (m/f/d), you’ll play a key role in shaping this platform and these software tools, from the database to the frontend. Your work directly reaches thousands of learners and contributes to the transformation of mid-sized and large German companies.

Your responsibilities

- Develop our adaptive, AI-first learning platform and software-based AI solutions end-to-end, independently making key technical architecture decisions

- Implement new features and requirements in our existing learning framework, balancing new development with ongoing improvements

- Build AI features into the platform, such as LLM-powered learning support, adaptive learning paths, or automated content generation, and ensure they run reliably, measurably, and cost-efficiently

- Build internal tools and AI automations for Learning Coaches, Client Operations, and Sales to help these teams work more efficiently

- Work closely with the entire engineering team, our Content Engineering team, and the Portfolio Leads

What you bring

- 5+ years of experience in full-stack development, several of them with senior responsibility (architecture, technical decisions, mentoring)

- You work AI-first and naturally use AI tools in your day-to-day engineering; the agentic SDLC isn’t a foreign concept to you but a target vision

- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs in products: prompt design, structured outputs, tool use, and evaluation of model outputs

- Experience with end-to-end development using Python (FastAPI or Django) and TypeScript/React

- Confident with PostgreSQL and schema migrations

- Discipline in testing and CI (e.g. pytest, typed code, GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience with Docker-based deployment and a foundation in observability

- Business-fluent English and ideally German at B1-B2 level

This role probably Isn’t for you if…

This role is probably not the right fit if you only want to work on greenfield projects. Alongside building our new platform, you’ll also continue developing our existing learning framework, and both are equally part of the job. It’s also not a good fit if you see AI tools as a nice extra rather than something that fundamentally changes how we build software. About us

EggAI is a fast-growing, 100% remote AI consulting and development startup based in Munich. We build agentic AI solutions for enterprise clients. We are growing in several European markets at the same time, are actively building our internal structures - and are looking for someone to help shape this growth phase.

Your role

You are our go-to person for day-to-day accounting. You make sure every receipt, invoice and expense ends up in the right place - cost center, account, country - and you prepare everything so that our external tax advisor can book without back-and-forth. You work across several European countries, with employees and freelancers, and with local payroll providers. We don’t have fully established processes yet, so you won’t just follow a playbook: you spot gaps, think the process through and set it up yourself. You work closely with our Head of Finance, who owns controlling, forecasting and reporting, and with our external tax advisor, who handles ongoing bookkeeping, annual financial statements and German payroll. You ideally bring your own experience from a tax advisory firm or a similar environment.

Your responsibilities

 

● Preparatory bookkeeping: Pre-code receipts and prepare them for ongoing bookkeeping by our tax advisor

● Receipt and invoice management: Collect receipts and incoming invoices, review them, and consistently follow up on open items

● Correct allocation: Make sure expenses are assigned to the correct cost center and the correct account in the chart of accounts

● Travel expenses across Europe: Manage per diems (meal allowances), mileage allowances and comparable expense rules across countries for our teams in Europe

● Employees & freelancers across Europe: Know the Europe-wide controlling and accounting topics that apply to employees and freelancers - or get up to speed on them quickly

● International payroll interface: Manage local payroll providers and salary payments

● Cash flow: Think along on cash flow structures & reporting, and keep them up to date

● Process setup: Independently think through and set up finance processes and structures in an international, growing environment

What you bring

Must have

● 4+ years of professional experience in finance & accounting

● German at a fluent professional level (C1/C2), including German accounting and tax terminology; English at least B1, as our team is diverse and English is often the working language

● Very good DATEV skills and solid understanding of the chart of accounts and correct account assignment

● Flexibility with tools: you quickly find your way around other systems such as Odoo

● You have owned finance and accounting topics end-to-end, without day-to-day guidance

● You are comfortable in gray areas and make good decisions even without complete information

Nice to have

● Completed commercial vocational training or a degree with a focus on finance, accounting or controlling

● Understanding of how a balance sheet should be structured to be meaningful for investors - ideally through your own experience in a tax advisory firm or similar environment

● Exposure to controlling topics such as cost centers, forecasts or project margins

● Motivated, proactive and creative personality with a hands-on mentality - you want to shape things, not just administer them

Why EggAI?

● 100% remote work in an international, highly motivated team

● Flat structures and direct access to the Head of Finance and the founders - short paths, fast decisions

● Freedom to shape: you help build the finance infrastructure of an AI scale-up from the ground up

● Insight into one of the most dynamic growth fields in tech and into building a company across Europe

Sounds like you?

We'd love to hear from you!

If your profile looks like a good match we'll be in touch to organise a first stage interview.

Please note, due to the high volume of candidates, we cannot offer personalized feedback to each candidate.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
About AMMP
AMMP builds software for the renewable energy sector: AMMP OS, the operating system for renewable energy portfolios. Developers, EPCs, asset owners, O&M providers and finance teams use it to monitor, operate and report on their sites. It connects 30+ inverter, battery and meter brands and covers 10,000+ sites in 35+ countries, many of them multi-vendor fleets.
We build the product with our customers, and their day-to-day problems set the roadmap (a missed outage, a savings report that takes a week to compile). In 2026 we launched Ray, an AI coworker that sits in Teams or Slack and answers questions about a customer's fleet in plain language. We're a small team, working remotely.
What you'll do
Onboarding (roughly 40% of your time)

• Run kickoff calls and collect what we need from each customer: site lists, vendor API credentials, PV orientation, target yield from PVsyst or Helioscope.

• Set up new organisations and assets in AMMP OS; connect vendor APIs, and data source selection.

• Configure and manage AMMP OS platform tailored to the customer's operation

• Test end to end before handover, then invite users and set their permissions.

• Work closely with other teams including but not limited to Software and Product Team.

Adoption and account health

• Track feature adoption and a health score for each account; we have a framework drafted and need someone to run it.

• Run quarterly check-ins with key accounts. Train users when adoption drops below target.

• Spot expansion: more MWp, an added module, Ray, the Data API.

Support

• Be the first point of contact.

• Triage data gaps, missing telemetry and billing questions; use our AI agents for first-line investigation and escalate the rest.

Renewals and feedback

• Feed recurring customer requests into the product backlog, with a clear write-up of who asked and why.

• Help us make onboarding faster. Today a 6-vendor customer takes about 10 hours of asset setup plus 20 hours of dashboard work; we want that number to fall.

What you'll bring
Must-haves

• 3+ years in customer success, technical account management or solutions engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

• Comfort with data. You can read an API response, write a basic SQL query, and spot when a number looks wrong.

• Clear written English; you'll write to customers in 35+ countries.

• You finish things. Onboarding has a lot of small steps, and missing one breaks the customer's first impression.

Nice-to-haves

• Experience with battery storage, gensets or hybrid systems.

• Working knowledge of solar PV: you know what an inverter, PR and yield are, and why a site underperforms.

• Grafana, Looker Studio or a similar BI tool.

• Python or Jupyter notebooks for small data jobs.

• Familiarity with inverter portals.

• Experience in emerging markets, especially sub-Saharan Africa or Latin America.

• French, Portuguese or Spanish.

What we offer

• A real say in how customer success works here; you'd be building the playbook, not following one.

• Work that cuts emissions: every site we monitor is solar or storage replacing diesel or grid power.

• A team that already uses AI agents in daily work, so you spend less time on copy-paste setup.

• Remote work and flexible hours.

• Salary: EUR 15,000-25,000/year

title: Head of Demand Planning & S&OP
description:
Forecasting at Rohlik currently drives operations across 12 fulfilment centres and 25,000 SKUs in five countries. Up until now, it has operated across local spreadsheets, individual judgement calls, and manual edits. It works, but it relies heavily on personal memory, lacks formal governance, and relies on manual routines.

As we continue to scale Europe’s leading online grocery delivery service, we are establishing Integrated Business Planning (IBP)/Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) as a brand-new Group department. The mission is to transform our current forecasting into an automated, governed, and scalable planning capability.

As Head of Demand Planning & S&OP, you will build this function from the ground up. You will own the Group demand forecast, establish the global S&OP cadence, build and lead the team, and work hand-in-hand with BI, Product, and Engineering to replace manual routines with modern, automated tooling.

Why this role is exciting

- Build from the ground up: This is a build role, not a position where you inherit an established setup. You will define the operating model, set governance across five markets, and recruit your own team.

- Direct C-level impact: You will stay close to the numbers daily, owning the daily forecast update delivered directly to the CEO, while framing strategic scenarios and trade-offs for executive decision-making.

- Automation & product ownership: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You will partner directly with BI and Engineering to automate planning inputs, create override logs, and launch automated plan-change notifications.

- Cross-functional authority: You won't just compile numbers. You will work at Director level to challenge Marketing uplifts, Commercial pricing, and Ops capacity, ensuring alignment across Commercial, Ops, and Finance.

- Multi-country scale: You will shape planning standards across all our active markets: the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania.

What you will own and deliver

- Build the department: Hire and develop the IBP/S&OP team, transition from single-person routines to a documented, resilient team structure with no single point of failure.

- Demand forecast & executive briefing: Own the Group demand forecast end-to-end and personally deliver the daily operational forecast brief to the CEO.

- S&OP cadence & operating plan: Establish the Group S&OP cycle, consolidating commercial, operational, and financial commitments into a single constrained operating plan.

- Governance & standards: Define planning responsibilities, KPI definitions, approval thresholds for manual adjustments, and escalation rules across CZ, HU, RO, DE, and AT.

- Automation roadmap: Act as the business owner for custom planning products, driving the rollout of mass uploads, automated locks, override logging, and instant plan-change alerts to Ops and Supply.

- Cross-functional alignment: Partner at Director level with Marketing, Commercial, Supply, Fulfilment, Last Mile, Finance, and BI, reconciling operational plans with financial outlooks.

- Forecast accuracy & stability: Drive plan attainment and forecast value added over statistical baselines, maintaining high forecast accuracy (targeting ≥ 98% on orders and orderlines).

What we are looking for

- Proven leadership in planning: 5+ years of progressive experience in Demand Planning, S&OP, Integrated Business Planning, or Supply Chain operational planning.

- Build track record: Demonstrated experience building or re-platforming a planning function from scratch - including team, processes, and tools.

- Automation mindset: Direct experience driving the automation of manual planning routines alongside BI, Data, or Engineering teams.

- Executive presence: Ability to distil complex, multi-market data into clear, concise updates for the CEO under tight deadlines.

- Multi-market oversight: Proven track record running S&OP or demand reviews across multiple countries, sites, or business units.

title: AI Tooling Engineer - Remote
description:
About Us
At Zyte , we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte . Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 225 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.
For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Today, over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.
This role sits in Zyte 's Tooling team, working side by side with our Principal Engineer in Tooling on an internal agentic platform: one place that brings together what the company knows, today spread across many systems, so that people and their AI agents get that context in one place, each seeing only what they are allowed to see.
We are looking for a builder: someone who has built AI agents and shipped them to real users, and who likes owning a product end to end, from talking with the people who use it to the code, the deployment and the numbers that say whether it works. The first version is already in use inside the company and grows every week.
Roles & Responsibilities:

• Build the platform with the Principal Engineer in Tooling: new capabilities every week, from design to production.

• Connect new internal systems and SaaS tools to the platform: their APIs and data, how they fit a shared model, and who may see what.

• Build agents and the tools they use, including MCP servers that agents across the company can call, and the context they need to answer well.

• Own quality: evaluation sets and benchmarks, tracing, cost per answer, and fixing what users run into.

• Turn proofs of concept into internal tools that run in production in the cloud, with security and access done properly.

• Build with AI coding agents as the main way of working, with the specs, tests and reviews that keep the code sound.

• Contribute to company-wide AI tooling initiatives: evaluating and standardising internal AI tools, cost and usage tracking, and agreed standards for AI-built internal apps; help other teams build on the platform.

• Talk with the people who use the platform, across the company, to learn what to build next, and explain what was built to technical and non-technical audiences.

Requirements

• 3+ years building and shipping production software, mostly in Python, with relational databases.

• Has built and shipped with LangGraph at least one agent that real people use: tool calling, retrieval and embeddings, prompt and context design.

• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs from the main providers, cost and token optimisation.

• Hands-on with MCP or similar tool protocols, as a server and as a client.

• Evaluates AI systems properly: test sets, LLM-as-judge, regressions when a prompt or a model changes; tracing and observability with Langfuse or similar.

• Integrates APIs and data: SaaS APIs, SQL, data warehouses.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure (Google Cloud and/or AWS): containers, managed databases, identity and access, CI/CD.

• Uses AI coding agents every day and knows how to keep their output in check.

• A sense for security and permissions: identity, least privilege, people see only what they are allowed to see.

• Comfortable with version control (GitHub/Bitbucket).

• Excellent written and spoken English, technical and non-technical.

Desired Skills:

• Familiarity with web data or web scraping.

• Django and Postgres, including vector search with pgvector.

• Enough frontend to build and change a chat interface (React, Next.js).

• Has built internal tools that colleagues adopted

title: Social Strategist, X and Insights
description:

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are investing in our owned social channels to grow share of voice and tell a clearer, more connected company story across LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube. We need someone to take direct ownership of X and run it day to day, while also maintaining consistent social performance data analysis across all of our owned channels.

This is a hands-on social strategy role for someone who knows how to build an interesting, credible and active presence on X. You will also work with the Social Manager to turn channel and audience data into clear recommendations about what Harvey should create, publish, test, stop and scale. The goal is a steady feedback loop between how our audience behaves, what our content strategy is and how our creative gets made.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

OWN X STRATEGY AND EXECUTION

- Own Harvey's X strategy, programming and daily execution.

- Develop a distinctive voice and a clear role for Harvey on the platform.

- Create posts built for X, not LinkedIn content with the formatting changed.

- Find proactive, reactive and real-time opportunities for Harvey to join relevant conversations.

- Support product launches, research, events, partnerships, customer stories and company announcements on X.

- Build recurring formats and programming that give people a reason to come back.

- Write and edit copy that is clear, sharp and right for the platform.

- Monitor replies, mentions and relevant conversations.

- Work with the Social Content and Community Manager on engagement and response coverage.

- Support founder, executive and employee amplification where it makes sense.

- Use sound judgment in moments that carry brand, reputational or customer sensitivity.

- Track changes to X and adjust our approach as the platform evolves.

MANAGING CROSS-CHANNEL INSIGHTS AND OPTIMIZATION

- Work with Social Manager and Social Content and Community Manager to pull weekly and monthly performance analysis across X, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.

- Collaborate with the social team to go beyond surface metrics and explain what actually drove performance.

- Identify patterns across format, topic, audience, timing, creative approach and distribution.

- Help turn findings into specific programming and creative recommendations.

- Work with third party analytics tools to track follower growth, reach, engagement, clicks, sentiment and other channel-specific signals.

- Analyze performance during major launches, events and campaigns utilizing third party analytics and channel analytics.

- Work with Content Operations on data accuracy, UTMs, reporting processes and dashboards.

- Bring audience and performance insight into quarterly strategy and planning.

Event & Inventory Coordination

Edge systems → cloud → AI pipelines → edge inference

Translate canonical semantic definitions into:

• Physical data models

• Schemas

• Pipelines

Ensure all data structures conform to:

• Enterprise standards

• Platform contracts

4. Enable Scalable AI Model Integration

Define data interfaces required by:

• Internal AI teams

• External model providers

Support:

• Model versioning

• Feature compatibility

• Performance validation

5. Design for Multi-Tenant and Product Use Cases

Ensure data pipelines and access patterns support multi-tenant environments, including:

• Customer data isolation and secure access controls

• Scalable onboarding of new tenants and use cases

• Reuse of data pipelines across customers and deployments

Note: The underlying data model for multi-tenancy is governed by the Principal Manufacturing & Semantic Architect.

description:

Denver, CO | Full Time | Onsite
About the role
FronteraCare is seeking an experienced Recruiter to own and scale our Registered Behavior Technician hiring across our existing markets. Few workflows in our business have as direct a line to patient care as RBT recruiting: every RBT hired is a child who can start or continue therapy, which makes this one of the most impactful roles at FronteraCare. This is a high-volume role for someone who has already built strong recruiting instincts and is ready to take a program that's up and running and push it further, improving speed, quality, and consistency as we grow. You'll travel to New Mexico periodically to stay close to the market and the teams you're hiring for.

You'll report to the Talent Lead and work alongside a Recruiter focused on emerging markets, with this role dedicated specifically to owning full-cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles in FronteraCare's established markets. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in high-volume, fast-moving recruiting environments, finds genuine reward in the grind of consistent high-volume hiring, and brings both process discipline and compassion to every candidate interaction.

What is ABA?
Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is a therapy that uses evidence-based techniques to help children with autism build communication, social, and daily living skills. Care is typically delivered one-on-one by Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians under the guidance of a licensed Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), with progress tracked closely so each child's plan can be adjusted as they grow.

What you'll do

• Own full cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles across FronteraCare's existing markets, from sourcing and screening through offer and onboarding handoff

• Take ownership of established sourcing channels and candidate pipelines, refining and scaling what's already working rather than building from scratch

• Maintain a high, consistent volume of active requisitions, balancing speed with quality in a fast-moving, high-turnover talent pool

• Travel to New Mexico periodically to build local candidate and community relationships and stay close to market conditions

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clinical leaders, BCBAs, and current RBTs to stay close to market needs, referral opportunities, and what makes candidates want to join and stay

• Partner with the Talent Lead, the emerging markets Recruiter, onboarding, and HR to keep processes efficient and aligned across the broader recruiting team

• Proactively source candidates using Indeed and other established sourcing platforms, with an eye toward continuous improvement of what's already in place

• Post job openings on job boards and social media channels

• Maintain accurate candidate records in Greenhouse and track key recruiting metrics

• Support additional recruiting projects and initiatives as needed to help the team meet its hiring goals

What you'll bring

• Associate's or bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field

• 3-5 years of recruiting experience in a high-volume setting, ideally in healthcare or behavioral health

• Demonstrated experience recruiting for junior or entry-level profiles, with a genuine appreciation for the pace and repetition that high-volume hiring requires

• A track record of taking an existing recruiting program and improving its speed, quality, or scale

• Familiarity with sourcing tools such as Indeed, as well as applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse experience a plus)

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

• Willingness and ability to travel to New Mexico periodically

• A compassionate, people-first mind

description:

Du hast Erfahrung mit ISO 27001, ISMS oder Information Security Consulting und liebst es, komplexe Themen einfach zu erklären? Du arbeitest gerne mit Kunden, denkst unternehmerisch und möchtest direkten Einfluss auf den Erfolg eines wachsenden SaaS-Unternehmens haben?
Dann könnte das dein nächster Karriereschritt sein.
Bei heyData machen wir Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit für Unternehmen einfacher. Unsere Plattform verbindet smarte Software mit persönlicher Expertenberatung - und hilft bereits über 3.000 Unternehmen, Compliance-Anforderungen erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Jetzt suchen wir dich als unseren ersten Solutions Engineer für Information Security (all genders).
Das Besondere: Du übernimmst nicht einfach eine bestehende Rolle. Du gestaltest mit, wie wir komplexe Security-Lösungen verkaufen, beraten und weiterentwickeln.
Deine Mission:
Du wirst zur fachlichen Stimme unseres Sales und Account Management Teams.
Unsere Account Executives & Account Manager führen die kommerziellen Gespräche. Du bringst die Security-Expertise ein, mit der aus interessierten Unternehmen überzeugte Kunden werden.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Sales, Produkt und unseren Security-Expert zusammen.
Konkret bedeutet das:

• Beraten statt Kaltakquise: Du steigst in qualifizierte Kundengespräche ein, verstehst Security-Herausforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungsansätze.

• Deine Expertise sichtbar machen: Du zeigst IT-Leitungen, CISOs und Geschäftsführungen, wie heyData bei ISO 27001, NIS2 und weiteren Compliance-Anforderungen unterstützt.

• Lösungen gestalten: Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team den richtigen Projektumfang und überzeugst Kunden mit nachvollziehbaren Empfehlungen.

• Den Vertrieb weiterentwickeln: Als erste Person in dieser Rolle entwickelst du Best Practices, Demo-Konzepte und Prozesse, die langfristig skalieren.

• Unser Produkt mitgestalten: Du bringst Kundenfeedback direkt zu unserem Produkt-Team und beeinflusst damit die Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattform.

Kurz gesagt: Du verbindest Security-Know-how mit Beratung, Produkt und Business Impact - ohne selbst klassische Kaltakquise betreiben zu müssen.
Deine Erfahrung:
Das ist uns wichtig:

• Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit ISO 27001 und Informationssicherheitsmanagement (ISMS) - zum Beispiel aus der Beratung, Implementierung oder einer internen Security-Rolle.

• Du kennst die Herausforderungen, vor denen Unternehmen bei der Einführung von Security- und Compliance-Prozessen stehen.

• Du kannst komplexe technische Themen verständlich erklären und fühlst dich in Kundengesprächen wohl.

• Du denkst lösungsorientiert, arbeitest eigenständig und möchtest mit deiner Expertise auch kommerziell etwas bewegen.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss:

• Erfahrung in Pre-Sales, Solutions Engineering oder SaaS

• Kenntnisse zu NIS2, TISAX oder weiteren Compliance-Frameworks

• Erfahrung mit Demos, Scoping oder technischen Verkaufsprozessen

• ISO-27001-Zertifizierungen

Du kommst aus der Security-Beratung und hast noch nie als Solutions Engineer gearbeitet?
Kein Problem. Wenn du Lust hast, näher am Produkt, an Kundenentscheidungen und am Business zu arbeiten, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.
Du musst nicht jede Anforderung zu 100 % erfüllen.
Wenn du Information Security verstehst, gerne mit Kunden arbeitest und Lust hast, eine neue Rolle mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: Product Marketer
description:
The brands on your kitchen shelf are run by people doing extraordinary work that nobody sees.

We're building the platform they run on, and a brand they'll be proud to be part of.

Confido is the AI operating system that runs cash application, deductions, trade and planning in one place for CPG brands. That means Finance, Sales, and Ops finally work on the same number.

We’re trusted by 250+ brands managing $30B+ in revenue, including Daisy, OLIPOP, Simple Mills, Idahoan, and more. We've achieved best-in-class growth and recently raised a $55M Series B led by Insight Partners to accelerate our momentum.

If you want your work on shelves everywhere - and outsized ownership while you build - we'd love to meet you.

ABOUT THE JOB

Most product marketers spend their careers making an average product sound better than it is. This role is the opposite.

We have built something rare: AI infrastructure that CPG teams genuinely love and will not give up. The stickiness is real, and category leaders keep choosing us. What we have not done yet is tell the world why we are better, and that gap is wide.

Today our positioning, customer proof, and competitive story are spread thin across the team. Our product is ahead of its story, and you close that gap. You own how our products show up in the market: how each area is positioned, why we win, and how we turn product and customer moments into demand. You power the GTM team with a story sharp enough to sell on, and you help define the category we are building.

This is a founding role. You are one of the first PMMs at Confido, here early enough to shape how the whole function works. Product Marketing reports to the VP of Marketing.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You own strategy, programming, and the moments: what gets said, to whom, and where. This is a role for someone who wants to make the thing, not brief it out.

Own

- Positioning, messaging, and narrative for the platform, sharpened as the product evolves

- Product-market clarity: the ICP, buyer, user, jobs to be done, alternatives, and why customers expand

- Product launches end to end: the plan, narrative, and cross-functional orchestration that turn new features into pipeline

- The customer-insight engine: lightweight automations (Gong, HubSpot, Zapier) that turn calls and win/loss into the themes, quotes, and proof that feed positioning and competitive intel

- GTM enablement: the battlecards, and messaging that arm reps to win

- Case studies and customer proof, sourced, written, and deployed into Sales hands at the right moment

- An integrated plan connecting the product roadmap to the marketing calendar across lifecycle, social, partnerships, AEO, and brand moments

HOW YOU'RE MEASURED

We measure product marketing on the pipeline it moves and the deals it wins, not on activity.

- Deal velocity and win rate (primary). Sharp positioning and enablement move qualified deals faster and beat the alternatives more often

- Influenced pipeline and its trajectory. Every deal maps to one of five motions: inbound, outbound, referral, partnerships, upsell. The signal that matters most is trajectory: the share of pipeline we build rather than rent, growing over time

- Launch impact. New products are measured on adoption and the pipeline they generate, not on shipping

- Enablement effectiveness. Reps are equipped, using your assets, and able to defend against competitors in live deals

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- 7+ years in product marketing. This is a clear PMM role, and we want someone who has done the craft, not an adjacent function

- Ideally in one of two worlds: CPG or commerce software, building the workflows our customers already live in, or B2B technology, where you translated genuinely complex products into clear entry points

- Excellent writing and narrative instincts. You turn a complex product into sharp, credible positioning

- Financial and quantitative fluency: comfortable reporting on pipeline influence and deal velocity

- Strong cross

Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

description:
ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are hiring a Content & Solutions Marketing Lead to define how OpenAI communicates the value of its advertising solutions to enterprise advertisers and agencies. You will build the narratives, content, customer proof, sales tools, and educational programs that help marketers understand the opportunity, make informed investment decisions, and achieve results.

Reporting to the Head of Global Large Advertiser Marketing, you will lead a function spanning enterprise advertising positioning and messaging, thought leadership, solutions storytelling, sales enablement, and customer education. You will translate product capabilities, customer insights, and performance evidence into clear, compelling materials for marketing leaders, media decision-makers, and the teams supporting them.

You will partner closely with Sales, Communications, Product Marketing, and Customer Marketing to create a consistent story across the customer journey. This role requires a strategic leader and exceptional storyteller who can build a scalable content operation while personally developing its most important narratives and materials.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Develop the enterprise advertising narrative. Own audience-specific positioning and messaging for enterprise advertisers and agencies, partnering with Product Marketing and Communications to ensure accuracy and consistency.

- Define the content strategy. Establish editorial priorities, formats, and distribution plans that address customer needs from initial awareness through evaluation, adoption, and growth.

- Build solutions narratives. Translate advertising capabilities into clear customer use cases, business benefits, and practical guidance tailored to advertiser objectives and agency needs.

- Create compelling thought leadership. Develop perspectives, executive presentations, research-based content, and other materials that help marketers understand the evolving role of AI in advertising.

- Build customer proof. Partner with Customer Marketing, Sales, and measurement teams to identify results and develop case studies, testimonials, and evidence that substantiate our advertising story.

- Equip Sales to communicate value. Own the marketing content supporting advertiser and agency conversations, including core pitch narratives, presentations, solution briefs, playbooks, and objection-handling materials.

- Develop scaled customer education. Create educational content and programs-including webinars, video, guides, and learning resources-that help advertisers and agencies build confidence and use OpenAI’s advertising solutions effectively.

- Establish a scalable content operation. Build processes for briefing, creation, review, localization, distribution, and maintenance so content remains accurate, accessible, and current.

At MarketFully Group, we’re on a mission to help the world’s most ambitious brands achieve growth InContent, InLanguage, InCulture, and InMarket. 👊 The Opportunity
We are working with a globally recognised automotive brand to support them in the SEO optimization.
Our client is a major multinational manufacturing automotive company. We already support this client with SEO content in several languages and currently we are looking for an SEO Specialist in Slovak.
In this project, we're creating US blog posts and localizing them into a wide range of other languages. • Native level Slovak speaker with a strong knowledge of the Slovak market.

• Background or demonstrable knowledge in automotive industry.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in SEO.

• Experience in using SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs with current subscription.

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Assignment Phase: You'll be requested to demonstrate your SEO knowledge.

If all this sounds like you, simply upload your CV/resume and complete the application form.

title: Infrastructure as Code Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Job Title: Infrastructure as Code Engineer
Location: Remote
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]
Salary Range: $115,000-$165,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10 + years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Infrastructure as Code Engineer to build, secure, automate, and operate cloud or enterprise infrastructure and platforms. The work focuses on availability, scalability, security, observability, automation, and dependable service operations. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in Terraform, reusable modules, remote state, cloud infrastructure, Git, CI/CD, and policy controls, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery
Key Responsibilities

• Design, provision, configure, and operate cloud or infrastructure components using approved architecture patterns.

• Automate repeatable provisioning, deployment, configuration, and operational tasks.

• Implement security, identity, networking, backup, monitoring, and availability controls.

• Investigate incidents, capacity issues, vulnerabilities, and performance problems.

• Maintain runbooks, diagrams, standards, and change records; collaborate across engineering and operations.

Required Qualifications

• Experience Required: typically 4+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition.

• Understanding of networking, identity, security, monitoring, and availability fundamentals.

• Experience with scripting, automation, source control, or infrastructure as code.

• Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and production issues methodically.

• Strong documentation and cross-team collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Additional hands-on depth in Terraform, reusable modules, remote state, cloud infrastructure, Git, CI/CD, and policy controls.

• Experience with cloud services, automation, and modern delivery practices relevant to the project.

• Familiarity with secure development, accessibility, governance, or regulatory requirements where applicable.

• Relevant professional certifications or advanced training in the role’s technology area.

Nice to have

CACI is seeking a Senior Endpoint Engineer to join our team on a contract supporting the Department of Homeland Security. As a Senior Endpoint Engineer, you will be part of a dynamic team of windows cloud engineers and security specialists with expert experience in Windows, Intune, Autopilot, Enterprise Patching, PKI/Certificates, Azure Active Directory, Virtualization, Cloud, and scripting experience. Responsibilities:

- Support Intune administration and engineering, to include compliance policies for conditional access, application deployment and patching, management and troubleshooting

- Use Windows Update for Business to keep Windows workstations patched to correct levels

- Create and deploy Intune configurations, policies, and settings

- Manage and maintain Windows 11 workstation baseline configurations

- Support and troubleshooting for Windows Autopilot

- Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term solutions

- Package software and updates for deployment in the test and production environments.

- Develop security baselines based on the recommendations from the Engineering and Security teams.

- Create reports on device compliance, application deployment, patch management, and software inventory

- Write PowerShell scripts to automate systems administration tasks

- Respond to escalated service desk/team requests

- Provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced systems engineers

- Communicate effectively (in oral and written form) with a variety of individuals; work well within small and large team environments

- Serves as liaison with clients, participating in meetings to ensure client needs are met

- Participates in special projects as required

Qualifications:

Required:
- Ability to attain DHS EOD

• BA + 10 years’ applicable experience, AA + 12 years’ applicable experience or 16 years’ experience

- Intune experience, supporting software packaging and patching

- Windows Autopilot experience

- EntraID (AzureAD) experience

- Expert knowledge of packaging, testing, deployment, and issue remediation

- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting

Desired:

- ITIL v3 or v4 certification

- MCSE Certified

- Endpoint Administrator Associate certification (Microsoft 365)

- STIG Policy experience

- Vulnerability Management experience

- Cloud Management experience

- AVD Management

A culture of integrity.
At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose - to ensure the safety of our nation.
An environment of trust.
CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
A focus on continuous growth.
Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground - in your career and in our legacy.
